note: The Checkling body. Every number here is content, read by care.mjs. Stats run 0 to 100, and weight 50 is a healthy build. The body clock ticks once for each school day the server was running (content/calendar.json says which days are not school days). Only Checklings in the party tick, the Den is paused. A school day the student checked in is a present day: decay is full and the ladder (condition, disease, death) can climb. A day the student was absent only decays down to the floors and never starts a condition, a disease or a death, so absence stings but never wrecks a Checkling.

medicine.label: Give medicine
medicine.say: {name} makes a face but swallows it.

obese.name: Obese
obese.tip: Too many full bowls. Skip the extra meals and play more.

scrawny.name: Scrawny
scrawny.tip: Not enough food. Feed a meal every visit.

bored.name: Bored
bored.tip: Nothing to do. Play with it.

wired.name: Wired
wired.tip: Played too hard today. It cannot nap until tomorrow.

lazy.name: Lazy
lazy.tip: Too many naps. Get it moving.

exhausted.name: Exhausted
exhausted.tip: No nap in days. Let it rest.

primped.name: Primped
primped.tip: Groomed to a shine. Harmless, mostly vain.

overtrained.name: Overtrained
overtrained.tip: Too many battles today. Give it a break.

out_of_shape.name: Out of shape
out_of_shape.tip: Has not battled in ages. Comfy, but soft.

diseaseRisk.note: Chance a condition turns into its disease on a present day: base plus perDay for every present day spent in it, up to cap. Slipping back into a condition counts its old days too, so bouncing in and out stays risky.

overmedicated.say: {name} was not sick. Now its tummy hurts.

illHealth.note: Health lost each present day a disease goes untreated.

glowing_mushroom.name: glowing mushroom
glowing_mushroom.say: {name} eats it. Its ears glow for a minute. It seems fine.
glowing_mushroom.label: Feed the glowing mushroom

egg.note: When a Checkling dies its trainer gets an egg at their next check-in. The egg hatches after hatchAfter more check-ins into one of the four starters, picked by the student.
